notes.title: Luminyte will be free to play
notes.content:
Hey folks, 

as from the middle of July the distribution of Luminyte will be changed to "FREE TO PLAY" in hope that some people will find the heart to play my little game!
Sadly I have to say my little experiment to enter the world of video game development about 2 years ago failed. Didn't have that great expectations though, so I think I'll be fine with it :)
Thanks to anyone who supported me!

See You,

Jens

notes.title: Added adjustable camera-height and updated camera-movement
notes.content:
Ahoi, I made some changes to the game, as I had some suggestions concerning the camera behavior.
I changed the camera-movement to feel a little more "natural" and maybe less vomit-triggering.
Also I added the possibilty to move the cam up and down via the mouse-scroll-wheel.
Along with some gameplay fixes, I hope you enjoy these changes. If not please let me know.
Best regards, Jens

notes.title: Still some Luminyte Beta-Keys available on Woovit
Releaseday
notes.content:
Hello folks,

I'm happy to say Luminyte is now available for sale and I'm really excited how everything will go on from now! I don't have great expectations but we'll see. At last I did learn a lot in the last year and the next project, if I find the time, will be much, much more sophisticated with more stuff and everything. 
Sadly I couldn't manage to add controller-support and changable key-bindings yet. I'll try to deliver that later on.
If I sell a lot of copys so that I will be able to quit my dayjob, fingers crossed, I will add everything of that and even more, and the sequel will be a blast :D

Thanks everyone and have a nice weekend!

Best Regards,

Jens

notes.title: Beta-Update / Soundtrack on Soundcloud
notes.content:
Hello folks,

thanks again for all of your mails regarding the Beta-Key lottery.
The lucky ones already got their grand prize. For all those who didn't win:
I'm really really sorry, but you don't have to wait much longer.
The release is getting close und you will be able to get your copy of Luminyte soon! ;)

Last Friday there was a small update after I received some first feedback.
Thanks to Aran for that!

I also wanted to say if you want to reset the game to beginn all over, or you just want to delete the game entirely from your computer after you uninstalled on steam, you have to the delete
the Baerenbytes folder in your [b]AppData->LocalLow[/b] folder.

Last but not least:
You can listen to the Soundtrack of the game on Soundcloud now: [url=https://soundcloud.com/audiosense-1/sets/luminyte-ost]Luminyte O.S.T.[/url]

Best regards,

Jens

notes.title: Some left BETA-Testing keys for free / French Localization
notes.content:
Hello everbody,

unfortunately I have some bad news concerning the french localization. Due to unforseen events
I have to skip the french language pack for the release of Luminyte. I will add it later to the game as soon as possible. I'm really sorry for that!

The good news is, I have some keys for BETA-testing left, which I will give out for free to the first
ones who will write an email to [b]info@baerenbytes.de[/b] with the subject: "[b]me first gimme gimme[/b]" :)

Entry deadline is the 9th of july 2021.

I really could use some more input to make Luminyte a better gaming experience.

Thanks and have a good day!

Jens
